a-file for the Ordenhedron polyform sequences (fixed / one-sided / free).

The Ordenhedron is a 15-faced space-filling polyhedron (3^6 4^3 5^2 6^2 7^2 faces) arising as the Voronoi cell of the orbit of the point (1/8, 1/6, 5/12) under space group Pn-3 (IT 201); its honeycomb has 24 cell types (translation classes), each cell with 15 face-neighbors.

Program: the table-driven Redelmeier enumerator published as the a-file of A398957 (enumerate.cpp).  Save a tables block below to tables.txt and run:  ./enumerate tables.txt N
With TABLES-FULL the output columns are n, fixed, free.
With TABLES-PROPER the 'free' column is the one-sided count (fixed column identical).
